engineered_features.origin_balance_delta: Difference between the origin account balance before and after the transaction: oldbalanceOrg - newbalanceOrig.
engineered_features.destination_balance_delta: Difference between the destination account balance after and before the transaction: newbalanceDest - oldbalanceDest.
engineered_features.amount_to_origin_balance_ratio: Transaction amount divided by the origin balance before the transaction, with safe handling for zero balances.
engineered_features.amount_to_destination_balance_ratio: Transaction amount divided by the destination balance before the transaction, with safe handling for zero balances.
engineered_features.origin_balance_change: Residual inconsistency at the origin account: amount minus origin_balance_delta.
engineered_features.destination_balance_change: Residual inconsistency at the destination account: amount minus destination_balance_delta.
engineered_features.transaction_amount_log: Natural log transform of amount using log1p.
engineered_features.is_high_value_transaction: Binary flag indicating whether the amount is above the fitted 95th percentile threshold from the training data.
engineered_features.zero_origin_balance: Binary flag showing whether the origin account started with zero balance.
engineered_features.zero_destination_balance: Binary flag showing whether the destination account started with zero balance.
engineered_features.balance_consistency_flag: Binary flag showing whether the origin and destination balance changes are both numerically consistent with the transaction amount.
engineered_features.transaction_type_frequency: Relative frequency of the transaction type learned from the training data and reused during inference.
engineered_features.account_drain_ratio: Share of the origin account balance represented by the transaction amount after safe division handling.

excluded_columns.nameOrig: Excluded from model inputs because it is a high-cardinality origin account identifier and would encourage memorization rather than generalizable behavior.
excluded_columns.nameDest: Excluded from model inputs because it is a high-cardinality destination account identifier and may leak entity identity.
excluded_columns.isFlaggedFraud: Excluded from model inputs because EDA showed it is strongly leakage-prone and nearly reveals the target directly.
excluded_columns.transaction_type_encoded: Handled inside the shared ColumnTransformer with OneHotEncoder instead of as a standalone engineered feature, which avoids duplicate logic and ordinal encoding artifacts.
